{{short description|German chemist}}

'''Sibylle Kemmler-Sack''' (18 November 1934 in [[Leipzig]] – 10 February 1999) was a German chemist.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?method=simpleSearch&cqlMode=true&query=nid%3D1146134029|title=Katalog der Deutschen Nationalbibliothek|website=portal.dnb.de|access-date=2019-04-25}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=opJXAAAAYAAJ|title=Nachrichten aus Chemie, Technik und Laboratorium|date=July 1994|publisher=Verlag Chemie.}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=9BocAQAAMAAJ|title=Attempto: Nachrichten für die Freunde der Tübinger Universität|year=1968}}</ref><ref name="ObradorsSandiumenge2000">{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=2Hpa66aAgacC&pg=PA563|title=Applied Superconductivity 1999: Large scale applications|author1=Xavier Obradors|author2=F. Sandiumenge|author3=J. Fontcuberta|publisher=Taylor & Francis|year=2000|isbn=978-0-7503-0745-1|pages=563–}}</ref> She was a professor for [[Chemistry]] at the [[University of Tübingen]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name="Werner2016">{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=a5h3DQAAQBAJ&pg=PA489|title=Geschichte der anorganischen Chemie: Die Entwicklung einer Wissenschaft in Deutschland von Döbereiner bis heute|author=Helmut Werner|date=7 November 2016|publisher=Wiley|isbn=978-3-527-33907-5|pages=489–}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.spiegel.de/spiegel/print/d-14336681.html|title=Neuer Farbstoff für Bildröhre|date=1981-08-10|work=Spiegel Online|access-date=2019-04-25|volume=33}}</ref>

== Life ==
Kemmler-Sack did her doctorate on "Untersuchungen an ternären Uran (V)oxiden" (Investigations on ternary [[uranium]] (V)oxides) in 1962.<ref name="Werner2016" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac.htm?method=simpleSearch&cqlMode=true&query=nid%3D106000527|title=Katalog der Deutschen Nationalbibliothek|website=portal.dnb.de|access-date=2019-04-25}}</ref><ref name="Kemmler1962">{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=JNspmwEACAAJ|title=Untersuchungen an ternären Uran(V)oxiden|author=Sibylle Kemmler|first=Sibylle|year=1962|type=Dissertation}}</ref> She habilitated in 1968 and the title of her habilitation thesis was "Über spektroskopische und magnetische Untersuchungen an Oxidfluoriden es fünfwertien Urans" (About [[Spectroscopy|spectroscopic]] and magnetic  investigations on oxide fluorides it five-valent uranium).<ref name="Werner2016" /> She became a university lecturer in 1968, an extraordinary professor in 1973, a university professor in 1978.<ref name="Werner2016" />

== Research ==
One focus of her work was the synthesis and characterization of [[perovskite]] phases.<ref name="Werner2016" /> She investigated their [[luminescence]] and their [[Conductivity (electrolytic)|conductivity]] in a systematic manner.<ref name="Werner2016" /> In the 1990s, she also [[Chemical synthesis|synthesized]] [[bismuth]] and bismuth[[Lead|/lead]] [[Superconductivity|superconducting]] [[cuprate]]s and investigated how the conductivity changed when Cu<sup>2+</sup> is gradually replaced by other transition metal [[Ion|ions.]]<ref name="Werner2016" />
